title: Workopolis Jobs Scraper
description: Scrape jobs from Workopolis.com listings. Provide either keyword/location OR a Workopolis search URL via Start URLs. The actor paginates and optionally scrapes detail pages.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: One or more Workopolis.com search URLs to start scraping from. If provided, these will be used instead of Keyword/Location fields. You can mix URLs with keyword-based searches.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Job search keyword(s). Examples: 'Software Developer', 'Marketing Manager', 'Data Analyst', 'Nurse', 'Sales Representative'. Leave empty if using Start URLs.

location.title: Location
location.description: Geographic location to search in. Examples: 'Toronto', 'Vancouver', 'Calgary', 'Montreal', 'Ottawa', 'Edmonton', 'Quebec City', 'Winnipeg', 'Halifax', 'Victoria'. Leave empty if using Start URLs.

posted_date.title: Posted Date
posted_date.description: Filter jobs by how recently they were posted. Only applies when using Keyword/Location search.

collectDetails.title: Collect job details
collectDetails.description: If enabled, the scraper will visit each job's detail page to extract the full description, salary information, and other detailed fields. If disabled, only basic information from the listing page will be collected.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of jobs
results_wanted.description: The maximum number of jobs to collect. The actor will stop after reaching this limit.

max_pages.title: Maximum number of pages
max_pages.description: A safety cap on the number of search result pages to visit. This prevents the actor from running indefinitely.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for the scraper. Using Apify Proxy with RESIDENTIAL proxies is strongly recommended to avoid being blocked.

cookies.title: Custom cookies (raw header)
cookies.description: Optional raw 'Cookie' header string. Can help bypass consent banners or maintain session state. Format: 'cookie1=value1; cookie2=value2'

cookiesJson.title: Custom cookies (JSON)
cookiesJson.description: Optional JSON-formatted cookies. Accepts an array (e.g., [{"name":"sessionid","value":"abc123"}]) or an object map (e.g., {"sessionid":"abc123"}).
